nbcb092151d.headline: China reportedly wants to curtail wasteful bitcoin mining
nbcb092151d.summary: China’s internet finance regulator is encouraging local governments to push bitcoin mining firms to exit by raising power prices and tightening environmental rules.
nbcb092151d.why: China is a major center for bitcoin mining; regulatory crackdowns affect global crypto supply and mining economics.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Mining restrictions reduce bitcoin network hash rate and may impact price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nbcb092151d.why_moved: China’s regulatory moves reduce bitcoin mining capacity, affecting supply and market sentiment.

n0bdd702b4a.headline: United Arab Emirates becomes largest investor in Egypt
n0bdd702b4a.summary: The UAE is Egypt's largest investor, with investments worth $6.2 billion across various service and production sectors.
n0bdd702b4a.why: Foreign direct investment inflows are critical for Egypt's economic growth, infrastructure development, and bilateral trade relations.

n4400e7497d.headline: Wages rise, but it will be difficult to afford
n4400e7497d.summary: Wages in Hungary continue to rise, with the minimum wage approaching subsistence level, but micro and small businesses may struggle to afford increases.
n4400e7497d.why: Wage growth affects consumer spending and inflation, while affordability issues may impact employment and business profitability.
